model.title: How did Pheidippides feel when he set off? Give evidence.

parts.text: Evidence: he "did not stop to rest" (short quotation)
Explain: this shows the message mattered more than his tiredness
Check: does it answer the question?

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: He felt determined because he did not stop to rest, which shows the message mattered more than his tiredness.

panels.title: Marks tell you how much to write

keywords.def: say why or how, using evidence

questions.q: V: In the text, the Athenians were outnumbered. What does outnumbered mean?
questions.a: There were more of the enemy than of them

questions.q: R: About how far is it from Athens to Sparta?
S: Summarise the first paragraph in one sentence
questions.a: For example: Athens needed help, so Pheidippides ran to Sparta to ask for it.

questions.q: Core: answer the comprehension questions on your own (portal quiz; 15 questions)
Spelling and grammar check: ten questions on relative clauses, parenthesis and fronted adverbials
Stretch: write one question of your own for each VIPERS type on the text
The text says Pheidippides ran to Sparta to ask for help. Why did he run?
questions.a: B) to ask Sparta for help. Retrieve it directly: he ran to ask the Spartans for help.
